setup: A performance-only driver breaks the sword arm using the damage resolver to enter P2. It continuously replenishes hero/boss health, acts through gameplay methods, and can destroy the remaining armor. The encounter, effects, sound, animation and AI stay active.
workload: 10 seconds of P2 warmup followed by three consecutive 60-second real-time windows in the cathedral. CPU, frame and GPU tracing enabled. The demo rendering process exited before the benchmark. The separate movie encoder used CPU near startup. Other desktop activity was uncontrolled.
metric: Nearest-rank 95th percentile of gameplay tick wall-clock intervals. Independent trace comparison uses the duration of the Game Frames track. The target applies to each 60-second window.
exit_note: The trace and all three measurement windows completed. The Development benchmark process exited with code -11 after game-engine shutdown. macOS diagnostic SoulBreak-2026-11-12-110259.ips. The fault occurred in logging an assertion during FPageAllocator static destruction.
insights: No-UI TimingInsights.ExportTimingEvents Game Frames track. Matched P2 entry and run-end engine frame IDs (log counters wrap at 1000), exact per-window sample counts, 10-second warmup and trace time span. A separate CSV contains only the measured intervals, tagged by run.
